description: This file defines a custom exception class `UserNotFoundException` used to indicate that a user resource was not found, either by ID or by username, extending a platform-specific base exception.

classes.name: UserNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException indicating that a user resource was not found, with constructors for ID-based and username-based exceptions.

methods.name: UserNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs a new exception indicating a user with the specified ID does not exist.

methods.name: UserNotFoundException(String userName)
methods.description: Constructs a new exception indicating a user with the specified username does not exist.
